digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, code-review scope extraction, clarity-check metric
propositions: Two regex patterns and one scope extractor key on '## Success Criteria' heading; until repointed the heading remains load-bearing and store migration cannot be verified.
'_count_ac_items' already counts checklist items only under '## Acceptance Criteria', so criteria under '## Success Criteria' never reach the P1 blocking floor.

Repointing the epic branch of '_clarity_score' from '## Success Criteria' to '## Acceptance Criteria' preserves the current score of 6 for the epic fixture (440 chars today, measured arithmetic: SC block removal + bonus repoint = 6, unchanged).

Seven test fixture files must be migrated: those with both headings drop the SC block; those with SC only must be renamed to '## Acceptance Criteria' with bullets converted to '- [ ]' checklist items.
All remaining occurrences of '## Success Criteria' must be in the new contract test 'test_criteria_heading_collapse.py', where they serve as negative-case probes demonstrating the heading is inert.
The two '_clarity_score' copies in gates.py and det_floor.py must remain textually in lockstep, preserving the invariant their comments assert.
